verdict.rationale: Pulumi natively supports encrypted secret configuration via `pulumi config set --secret`, using PULUMI_CONFIG_PASSPHRASE or cloud KMS to encrypt values at rest and mask them in CLI/console output, confirmed by the probe showing local state backend using PULUMI_CONFIG_PASSPHRASE for state secrets encryption; however, no direct doc evidence in the pack explicitly describes secret masking in logs or secret provider configuration, so the story is only partially substantiated by the available evidence.
